shortDescription: Ensure Cloudflare DNS record information is gathered

options.name: account_api_key
options.description: Cloudflare account API key. Required together with O(account_email) if O(api_token) is not provided.

options.name: account_email
options.description: Cloudflare account email. Required together with O(account_api_key) if O(api_token) is not provided.

options.name: api_token
options.description: Cloudflare API token. Required if O(account_email) and O(account_api_key) are not provided. Can be specified in E(CLOUDFLARE_TOKEN) environment variable.

options.name: record
options.description: DNS record name to filter by.

options.name: type
options.description: DNS record type to filter by.

options.name: zone_id
options.description: Zone identifier. Required if O(zone_name) is not provided.

options.name: zone_name
options.description: Zone domain name. Required if O(zone_id) is not provided. Resolved to zone identifier via the Cloudflare API.
